timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Wait, AI agents need Conditional Access too? They are not people.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They are identities performing actions. That makes them very interesting to attackers.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So what can we check if there is no human logging in?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Workload identity, resource scope, risk signals, network location, device context, and requested action.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Could an agent just get global admin?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Only if someone enjoys starring in incident reports. Agents need narrow roles and time-bound access.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Treat every connector as a data path. Approve it, log it, and restrict what it can reach.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: So Zero Trust applies to bots too?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Especially bots. Verify explicitly, grant least privilege, and assume the prompt can be hostile.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Good. Ominous is cheaper than breach recovery.
